label: early original-phase steps shortly after a p input
explanation: Fires during the original (input) phase at early positions (t=1..5, mass peaking at t=2-4) in the 1-3 steps after the letter p was input. prev_tok=p has 14x lift and holds 51% of the mass; prev2_tok=p 12x; first_tok=p 8x. The largest activations (~8) come from sequences starting with a run of p (p p p X), peaking on the token right after the run. It does not fire at t=0, almost never at t>=6, never in the copy phase, and only weakly on the delimiter (1% of mass). The current input token matters little. Missed activations (about 25% of active steps, 6% of mass) are mostly tiny, low-quartile activations at t=3 with no p nearby. False positives are mostly at t=4-5, where the feature is weaker.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=1 & prev_tok=p (+9.88), prev2_tok=p (+8.21), prev_tok=p (+6.69), t=3 (+5.52), orig1=p (+5.09), orig2=p (+4.06). Lower it: phase=2 (-9.79), prev_tok=c (-8.13), t=7 (-7.37), prev_tok=e (-7.25).
